title: Sudatto
text: 1. Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Sudatto devaputto Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || || Sattiyā viya omaṭṭho || ḍayhamāno va matthake || kāmarāgappahānāya || sato bhikkhu paribbaje ti || || 2. Sattiyā viya omaṭṭho || ḍayhamāno va matthake || sakkāya diṭṭhippahānāya || sato bhikkhu paribbaje ti || ||
